_meta.note: Hover micro-lines display as private text on the hovering player's screen only. A sparkle pulses on everyone else's screen when any player confirms a choice.

beats.text: Today is a birthday. Yours, and your siblings'.
Not quite yet, however. You are still incomplete.
A soul, floating in the Nothingness.
I shall allow you to participate in the creation process. It is your body, after all.

beats.title: What do you wish to be?

hoverLines.Purifier: My most perfect creation. It harms, it heals, and it never hesitates.
hoverLines.Alpha: My first creation. All it knows is how to break others.
hoverLines.Epsilon: The middle child. Magnificent against many. I gave it many tools, but it needs its siblings.
hoverLines.Omega: The youngest. Its ego is unmatched — it forces its world upon others.
hoverLines.Bandit: Quick fingers, quicker feet. I never know what it will bring back. Perhaps a lucky soul could.
hoverLines.Burnt: I was trying for something a bit sweeter...

beats.text: Here is a question you cannot yet understand. Answer it anyway.

lines.line: Health points, the measure of your very survival.
Attack, the measure of your physical prowess.
Competence Points, the measure of your magical capacity.
Espirit, the measure of your magical prowess.
Defense, the measure of your durability.
Agility, the measure of your speed.
Resistance, the measure of your immunity.
Luck, I always forget about this one. It only measures the unseen.

beats.title: A want is a small, selfish thing. Too small for me to choose for you.
All living things carry one. You will not be an exception.
This one, you must insist upon. It is the reflection of your very existence.

textIf: But not one that is sustainable in a world such as this.

beats.text: The most important piece of all.

beats.caption: A distant silhouette of the Queen's seat of power. No figure visible.

beats.text: Her people have never seen her.
She is building a perfect world.
Upon the corpses of her subjects.

beats.caption: Workers, heads down, repetitive animation loops. Above them, at the edge of frame, something large stands motionless. It is never mentioned.

beats.text: They are afraid of the world.
They will be afraid of you.
It will not be possible so long as the Queen and her Guardians still control this world.

beats.title: Finally — how do you feel about my creation?
